review_type: independent source review plus synthetic-test design and test-log inspection; no real data execution by reviewer

checks.prediction_only_generation: generate/_generate_clip only consume plan, prediction NPY, metadata and checkpoint SHA; no Scene, boxes, masks or target CSV read before sealed manifest
checks.teacher: t>=60 and logit>=0 inclusive, exact zero retained, plateau grouping and deterministic score/y/x top300
checks.association: dt<=3, Euclidean distance<=10*dt; penalty exceeds all valid costs, maximum valid cardinality then minimum distance
checks.fit: first observation through first+39 only, >=10 observations span>=9, separate stop/CV RMS<=3; later observations do not alter model fit or fit-score rank
checks.projection: both accepted models, every early frame, all raw status records retained, independent per-model/frame NMS <=3 using fit count, teacher score, track ID
checks.evaluation: sealed generation hashes verified before GT read; matching to all GT one-to-one independently of baseline hit; each unassigned kept point wrong including empty-GT frames and 3..8px distances
checks.numerical_boundary: centered closed-form OLS, same estimator/parameters, preserves tested exact x=0 backcast boundary
checks.output_scope: box-frame/Euclidean3px diagnostic; no official component claim and no training/GO decision

tests.added_integration: No GT file during generation; modified GT does not alter generation hashes; every empty-GT or 5px wrong candidate counted in evaluation

limitations: This review does not claim scientific adequacy of the fixed motion assumptions or thresholds.
Real M2 outputs still require arithmetic/provenance verification after completion.
